_description: Gistify-style benchmark tasks. Each entry describes a test-case-per-repo that our tool must reduce while preserving output. Modeled on the Gistify paper (Lee et al., ICLR 2026, arXiv 2510.26790) — same evaluation shape, but a custom test selection because the paper's exact 25-test list isn't publicly released.
_repo_note: requests and flask are from the paper's repo set. tomlkit is NOT — it was added so leave-one-repo-out cross-validation has three folds instead of two, and deliberately has a different shape: a flat package layout rather than src/, and tests driven by real .toml fixture files. Numbers on tomlkit are ours alone and are not comparable to anything in the paper.
_evaluation_note: Execution Fidelity per Gistify: 1 iff runs(c, G) AND out(c, G) = out(c, C). Success = 1 if the reduced project still runs the same test command with the same output (after our validator's normalize step).
_test_selection_criteria: Pure-Python tests (no network, no fixtures needing a running service) that exercise a bounded slice of the codebase. Kept intentionally small so the harness runs in reasonable time on a laptop.

tasks.notes: Exercises requests.utils.super_len — the len() variant that handles partially-read file objects.
Class of 8 tests for BOM-based JSON encoding detection. All pure-Python, no network.
add_dict_to_cookiejar over both cookielib.CookieJar and RequestsCookieJar (2 parametrized cases).
Basic Flask route registration + method matching. Small surface.
Blueprint-scoped error handling. Exercises the blueprint machinery.
Parses 11 real .toml fixture files from tests/examples/. Data-driven: the reducer must keep the parser intact while the inputs live outside the .py files it can touch.
Array item machinery — list protocol over the style-preserving container.
TOMLDocument's mapping protocol. Exercises container.py rather than the parser.
Serialization/escaping path. Smallest slice of the four tomlkit surfaces, and the cheapest task to re-run.
